'import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import textwrap

RATIOS = [
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'', ''Leverage_Ratio'', ''ROA'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'', ''CurrentAssets_Ratio'',
    ''MarketValue_Liabilities'', ''Log_TotalAssets''
]

LABEL = {
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'': ''Thanh toan hien hanh'',
    ''Leverage_Ratio'': ''Tong no / Tong TS'',
    ''ROA'': ''ROA'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio'': ''LN giu lai / Tong TS'',
    ''CurrentAssets_Ratio'': ''TS ngan han / Tong TS'',
    ''MarketValue_Liabilities'': ''Von hoa / Tong no'',
    ''Log_TotalAssets'': ''Log tong tai san''
}

# MINT & CORAL
BOX_FILL = ''#D9F0E8''
BOX_EDGE = ''#218C74''
MEDIAN = ''#B42345''
WHISKER = ''#E76F7A''
FLIER = ''#D94F70''
INK = ''#252525''
MUTED = ''#667085''
GRID = ''#E8EDF2''

HEAVY = [
    ''Liquidity_Ratio'', ''Leverage_Ratio'', ''ROA'',
    ''Retained_Earnings_Ratio''
]

missing = [c for c in RATIOS if c not in dataset.columns]

if missing:
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 3))
    ax.text(
        0.02, 0.95, ''Thieu cot: '' + '', ''.join(missing),
        va=''top'', fontsize=12, wrap=True
    )
    ax.axis(''off'')
    plt.show()

else:
    data = dataset[RATIOS].apply(pd.to_numeric, errors=''coerce'')

    # Khung gon hon
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(
        1, 7, figsize=(15, 6), dpi=150
    )
    fig.patch.set_facecolor(''white'')

    for ax, c in zip(axes, RATIOS):
        s = data[c].replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).dropna()
        ax.set_facecolor(''white'')

        if len(s) == 0:
            ax.text(
                0.5, 0.5, ''Khong co du lieu'',
                ha=''center'', va=''center'',
                transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=10
            )
            ax.set_title(LABEL[c], fontsize=11, pad=3)
            ax.set_xticks([])
            ax.set_yticks([])
            continue

        ax.boxplot(
            s,
            widths=0.65,
            whis=1.5,
            patch_artist=True,
            showfliers=True,
            boxprops=dict(
                facecolor=BOX_FILL,
                edgecolor=BOX_EDGE,
                linewidth=1.5
            ),
            medianprops=dict(color=MEDIAN, linewidth=2.5),
            whiskerprops=dict(color=WHISKER, linewidth=1.2),
            capprops=dict(color=WHISKER, linewidth=1.2),
            flierprops=dict(
                marker=''o'', markersize=2,
                markerfacecolor=FLIER,
                markeredgecolor=''none'', alpha=0.35
            )
        )

        if c in HEAVY:
            ax.set_yscale(''symlog'', linthresh=1)

        # Tieu de to, khoang cach nho
        ax.set_title(
            ''\n''.join(textwrap.wrap(LABEL[c], width=15)),
            fontsize=11,
            color=INK,
            fontweight=''bold'',
            pad=4
        )

        ax.set_xticks([])
        ax.yaxis.grid(True, color=GRID, linewidth=0.6)
        ax.set_axisbelow(True)

        for side in [''top'', ''right'', ''bottom'']:
            ax.spines[side].set_visible(False)

        ax.spines[''left''].set_color(''#D0D5DD'')
        ax.spines[''left''].set_linewidth(0.6)

        ax.tick_params(
            axis=''y'', labelsize=10,
            length=0, colors=MUTED, pad=1
        )

    # Giam padding cac phia
    fig.subplots_adjust(
        left=0.035,
        right=0.998,
        top=0.91,
        bottom=0.035,
        wspace=0.22
    )

    plt.show()'
'Boxplot thể hiện ngoại lai của 7 tỉ số'
